verses.original: ה֣וֹי הַיֹּרְדִ֤ים מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה עַל־ סוּסִ֖ים יִשָּׁעֵ֑נוּ וַיִּבְטְח֨וּ עַל־ רֶ֜כֶב כִּ֣י רָ֗ב וְעַ֤ל פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ כִּֽי־ עָצְמ֣וּ מְאֹ֔ד וְלֹ֤א שָׁעוּ֙ עַל־ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w hay·yō·rə·ḏîm miṣ·ra·yim lə·‘ez·rāh ‘al- sū·sîm yiš·šā·‘ê·nū way·yiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ‘al- re·ḵeḇ kî rāḇ wə·‘al pā·rā·šîm kî- ‘ā·ṣə·mū mə·’ōḏ wə·lō šā·‘ū ‘al- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh lō ḏā·rā·šū
verses.literal: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help who rely on horses who trust in their abundance of chariots . . . and in their multitude . . . of horsemen . . . They do not look to the Holy One of Israel they do not seek the LORD

verses.original: וְגַם־ ה֤וּא חָכָם֙ וַיָּ֣בֵא רָ֔ע וְאֶת־ דְּבָרָ֖יו לֹ֣א הֵסִ֑יר וְקָם֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית מְרֵעִ֔ים וְעַל־ עֶזְרַ֖ת פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- hū ḥā·ḵām way·yā·ḇê rā‘ wə·’eṯ- də·ḇā·rāw lō hê·sîr wə·qām ‘al- bêṯ mə·rê·‘îm wə·‘al- ‘ez·raṯ pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster He does not call back His words He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers . . .

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֤יִם אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ אֵ֔ל וְסוּסֵיהֶ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וְלֹא־ ר֑וּחַ וַֽיהוָ֞ה יַטֶּ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וְכָשַׁ֤ל עוֹזֵר֙ וְנָפַ֣ל עָזֻ֔ר וְיַחְדָּ֖ו כֻּלָּ֥ם יִכְלָיֽוּן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim ’ā·ḏām wə·lō- ’êl wə·sū·sê·hem bā·śār wə·lō- rū·aḥ Yah·weh yaṭ·ṭeh yā·ḏōw wə·ḵā·šal ‘ō·w·zêr wə·nā·p̄al ‘ā·zur wə·yaḥ·dāw kul·lām yiḵ·lā·yūn
verses.literal: But the Egyptians are men not God their horses are flesh not spirit When the LORD stretches out His hand the helper will stumble and the one he helps will fall both will perish together

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֵלַ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶהְגֶּה֩ הָאַרְיֵ֨ה וְהַכְּפִ֜יר עַל־ טַרְפּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקָּרֵ֤א עָלָיו֙ מְלֹ֣א רֹעִ֔ים מִקּוֹלָם֙ לֹ֣א יֵחָ֔ת וּמֵֽהֲמוֹנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יַֽעֲנֶ֑ה כֵּ֗ן יֵרֵד֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לִצְבֹּ֥א עַל־ הַר־ צִיּ֖וֹן וְעַל־ גִּבְעָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay ka·’ă·šer yeh·geh hā·’ar·yêh wə·hak·kə·p̄îr ‘al- ṭar·pōw ’ă·šer yiq·qā·rê ‘ā·lāw mə·lō rō·‘îm miq·qō·w·lām lō yê·ḥāṯ ū·mê·hă·mō·w·nām lō ya·‘ă·neh kên yê·rêḏ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ liṣ·bō ‘al- har- ṣî·yō·wn wə·‘al- giḇ·‘ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD has said to me Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey and though a band of shepherds is called out against it it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor . . . so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights

verses.original: כְּצִפֳּרִ֣ים עָפ֔וֹת כֵּ֗ן יָגֵ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם גָּנ֥וֹן וְהִצִּ֖יל פָּסֹ֥חַ וְהִמְלִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣip·po·rîm ‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ kên yā·ḡên Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim gā·nō·wn wə·hiṣ·ṣîl pā·sō·aḥ wə·him·lîṭ
verses.literal: Like birds hovering overhead so the LORD of Hosts . . . will protect Jerusalem He will shield it and deliver it He will pass over it and preserve it

verses.original: שׁ֗וּבוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֛ר הֶעְמִ֥יקוּ סָרָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇū la·’ă·šer he‘·mî·qū sā·rāh bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled O children of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֚י בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִמְאָס֗וּן אִ֚ישׁ אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וֶאֱלִילֵ֖י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם יְדֵיכֶ֖ם חֵֽטְא׃
verses.transliteration: kî bay·yō·wm ha·hū yim·’ā·sūn ’îš ’ĕ·lî·lê ḵas·pōw we·’ĕ·lî·lê zə·hā·ḇōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lā·ḵem yə·ḏê·ḵem ḥêṭ
verses.literal: For on that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver . . . and gold that your own hands have sinfully made

verses.original: וְנָפַ֤ל אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּחֶ֣רֶב לֹא־ אִ֔ישׁ וְחֶ֥רֶב לֹֽא־ אָדָ֖ם תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ וְנָ֥ס לוֹ֙ מִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וּבַחוּרָ֖יו לָמַ֥ס יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·p̄al ’aš·šūr bə·ḥe·reḇ lō- ’îš wə·ḥe·reḇ lō- ’ā·ḏām tō·ḵă·len·nū wə·nās lōw mip·pə·nê- ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇa·ḥū·rāw lā·mas yih·yū
verses.literal: Then Assyria will fall but not by the sword of man a sword will devour them but not one made by mortals They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor

verses.original: וְסַלְעוֹ֙ מִמָּג֣וֹר יַֽעֲב֔וֹר וְחַתּ֥וּ מִנֵּ֖ס שָׂרָ֑יו נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ א֥וּר לוֹ֙ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְתַנּ֥וּר ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·sal·‘ōw mim·mā·ḡō·wr ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr wə·ḥat·tū min·nês śā·rāw nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ă·šer- ’ūr lōw bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·ṯan·nūr lōw bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Their rock will pass away for fear and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard declares the LORD whose fire is in Zion whose furnace is in Jerusalem
